units: MIG-GPU hours on comparable H100 1g.12gb slices; not full-H100-equivalent hours

qlora.caveat: Training proxy from actual native-input historical checkpoint intervals; new Level-1 gradient throughput was not measured because Qwen training is not authorised. IQR describes recorded timing variation, not uncertainty in this representation transfer.

dora.caveat: Training proxy from actual native-input historical checkpoint intervals; new Level-1 gradient throughput was not measured because Qwen training is not authorised. IQR describes recorded timing variation, not uncertainty in this representation transfer.

scheduling: Two DoRA branches plus one QLoRA start; second QLoRA follows on its released slice. For twelve branches, six DoRA jobs then six QLoRA jobs balance four waves over three slices. Existing four CLAUDS slices are not counted.

storage.convention: Uncompressed float32 logits+probability mass dominate prediction estimate; NPZ often smaller, no assumed compression ratio. Two rotating full resume slots, selected/final exports and validation PDFs retained; base checkpoint is shared.
